age-calc.title: Age Calculator – Exact Age in Years, Months, Days
age-calc.metaDescription: Calculate precise age from birthdate including leap years.
age-calc.introduction: Enter the date of birth to get years, months and days.

faqs.question: Does it consider leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes—calculations use real calendar math including leap years.

faqs.question: Can it compute future age?
faqs.answer: Yes—enter a future date as reference to compute age at that date.

faqs.question: Is timezone relevant?
faqs.answer: Age uses local date; timezone differences rarely affect calendar day calculation.

area.title: Area Calculator – shapes: circle, rectangle, triangle
area.metaDescription: Compute area for standard shapes with given dimensions.
area.introduction: Select shape, enter dimensions, and calculate area.

faqs.question: Area of circle?
faqs.answer: Area = π × r².

faqs.question: Rectangle area?
faqs.answer: Area = length × width.

faqs.question: Triangle area?
faqs.answer: Area = 0.5 × base × height.

bmi-calc.title: BMI Calculator – Free Online Body Mass Index Tool
bmi-calc.metaDescription: Calculate BMI from weight and height. Free, fast, and accurate.
bmi-calc.introduction: Instantly calculate your Body Mass Index (BMI) using weight (kg) and height (cm).

faqs.question: What is BMI?
faqs.answer: BMI (Body Mass Index) estimates body fat from weight and height.

faqs.question: What is a healthy BMI range?
faqs.answer: For adults, 18.5–24.9 is generally considered healthy.

faqs.question: Is BMI accurate for athletes?
faqs.answer: Athletes may have high BMI due to muscle mass; BMI doesn't distinguish muscle from fat.

bmr.title: BMR Calculator – Basal Metabolic Rate Tool
bmr.metaDescription: Estimate calories burned at rest using Mifflin-St Jeor formula.
bmr.introduction: Calculate Basal Metabolic Rate using age, sex, weight and height.

faqs.question: What is BMR?
faqs.answer: BMR is calories burned at rest to maintain vital functions.

faqs.question: Which formula is used?
faqs.answer: We use Mifflin-St Jeor, widely accepted for estimates.

faqs.question: Can I use BMR for diet planning?
faqs.answer: Yes—multiply BMR by an activity factor to get daily needs.

bodyfat.title: Body Fat Calculator – U.S. Navy Method
bodyfat.metaDescription: Estimate body fat percentage using waist, neck, hip (for women) measurements.
bodyfat.introduction: Use the U.S. Navy formula for estimated body fat percentage.

faqs.question: Is this accurate?
faqs.answer: It's an estimate; professional methods (DEXA) are more accurate.

faqs.question: Do measurements need units?
faqs.answer: Use all measurements in centimeters.

faqs.question: Is it suitable for athletes?
faqs.answer: Athletes may have atypical results due to muscle distribution.

calorie.title: Calorie Calculator – Daily Calorie Needs
calorie.metaDescription: Estimate daily calorie needs (TDEE) from BMR and activity level.
calorie.introduction: Calculate daily calories by selecting activity level and body stats.

faqs.question: What is TDEE?
faqs.answer: Total Daily Energy Expenditure is calories burned per day including activity.

faqs.question: How to use this?
faqs.answer: Compute BMR then multiply by an activity factor (1.2 sedentary to 1.9 very active).

faqs.question: Is it precise?
faqs.answer: It's an estimate; use it as a starting point and adjust with real-world results.

interest.title: Compound Interest Calculator – Investment Growth
interest.metaDescription: Calculate future value with compound interest and compounding frequency.
interest.introduction: Enter principal, rate, years and compounding periods per year.

faqs.question: What is compounding?
faqs.answer: Interest calculated on principal and previously earned interest.

faqs.question: How does frequency affect growth?
faqs.answer: More frequent compounding yields slightly higher returns.

faqs.question: Is rate annual?
faqs.answer: Yes—enter annual rate; specify compounding periods per year.

countdown.title: Countdown Timer – Event Countdown
countdown.metaDescription: Countdown to a future date/time with days, hours, minutes and seconds.
countdown.introduction: Enter a target date/time and start the live countdown.

faqs.question: Can I set multiple countdowns?
faqs.answer: This page supports a single countdown; extend UI to save multiple.

faqs.question: What happens when time's up?
faqs.answer: You can configure alerts or redirect when countdown reaches zero.

faqs.question: Is timezone considered?
faqs.answer: The target date/time is interpreted in the user's local timezone.

currency.title: Currency Converter – Convert World Currencies
currency.metaDescription: Convert currencies using daily-updated exchange rates (rates cached daily).
currency.introduction: Enter amount and select currency pair. Note: rates are indicative; use banks for exact quotes.

faqs.question: Are rates live?
faqs.answer: This static package contains example rates. Use a rates API (ex: exchangerate.host) for live rates.

faqs.question: Which currencies?
faqs.answer: Common currencies included; you can add any ISO currency.

faqs.question: Are fees included?
faqs.answer: Displayed rates do not include conversion fees charged by banks or services.

date.title: Date Calculator – Add/Subtract Days & Difference
date.metaDescription: Add or subtract days/months/years and compute differences between dates.
date.introduction: Useful for deadlines, planning, and countdowns.

faqs.question: Does it handle leap years?
faqs.answer: Yes—uses JS Date which follows Gregorian calendar rules.

faqs.question: Can I add months?
faqs.answer: Adding months needs careful handling due to varying month lengths; this tool supports month addition.

faqs.question: Is time-of-day considered?
faqs.answer: This tool works in calendar days; time-of-day may affect partial days calculation.

fraction.title: Fraction Calculator – Add/Subtract/Multiply/Divide
fraction.metaDescription: Perform fraction arithmetic with simplification to lowest terms.
fraction.introduction: Input fractions as numerator/denominator and choose an operation.

faqs.question: Can it simplify results?
faqs.answer: Yes—results are simplified to lowest terms using GCD.

faqs.question: Does it support mixed numbers?
faqs.answer: Current UI accepts simple fractions; extend to mixed numbers if needed.

faqs.question: Is division by zero handled?
faqs.answer: Denominator zero is invalid and prompts an error.

loan.title: Loan / EMI Calculator – Monthly Payments
loan.metaDescription: Compute EMI, total payment, and total interest for loans.
loan.introduction: Enter principal, annual rate (%) and term (years) to compute monthly EMI.

faqs.question: What is EMI?
faqs.answer: Equated Monthly Installment to repay loan with interest over term.

faqs.question: Does rate accept annual value?
faqs.answer: Yes—enter annual rate; calculator uses monthly rate internally.

faqs.question: Can I include taxes?
faqs.answer: This calculator focuses on principal & interest; add taxes separately.

mortgage.title: Mortgage Calculator – Home Loan Estimator
mortgage.metaDescription: Estimate mortgage payments for home loans with principal and interest.
mortgage.introduction: Compute monthly mortgage payments and total cost.

faqs.question: What additional costs exist?
faqs.answer: Taxes, insurance, and HOA fees may add to monthly payment.

faqs.question: Can I change amortization?
faqs.answer: Shorter term increases payment but reduces interest paid.

faqs.question: Is rate fixed?
faqs.answer: Depends on loan—fixed stays same; adjustable can change over time.

percentage.title: Percentage Calculator – Percent, Increase, Decrease
percentage.metaDescription: Calculate percentages, part-of-whole, and percentage changes.
percentage.introduction: Use for discounts, grades, and ratio calculations.

faqs.question: How to find percent?
faqs.answer: (part/whole)×100 gives the percent value.

faqs.question: How to compute percent change?
faqs.answer: ((new-old)/old)×100 produces percent change.

faqs.question: Can I use negative values?
faqs.answer: Yes—negative indicates decrease.

qr-generator.title: QR Code Generator – Create QR Images
qr-generator.metaDescription: Generate QR codes for URLs and text (client-side).
qr-generator.introduction: Enter text or URL and generate a downloadable QR image.

faqs.question: Is generation offline?
faqs.answer: This implementation uses a public QR image API; to run fully offline use a client JS QR lib.

faqs.question: Can I change size?
faqs.answer: Yes—adjust size parameter when requesting the QR image.

faqs.question: Is data stored?
faqs.answer: No—the API generates an image; we do not store submitted data.

random.title: Random Number Generator – Integers & Picks
random.metaDescription: Generate random integers in a range or pick random choices.
random.introduction: Specify min and max to generate a random integer.

faqs.question: Is it cryptographically secure?
faqs.answer: No—use Web Crypto API for crypto-grade randomness.

faqs.question: Can I generate floats?
faqs.answer: Yes—adapt function to use Math.random() scaled to decimal range.

faqs.question: Can I pick from a list?
faqs.answer: Yes—add choice splitting and pick randomly from array.

scientific.title: Scientific Calculator – Trig, Log, Power
scientific.metaDescription: Basic scientific functions: sin, cos, tan, log, exponent, power.
scientific.introduction: Enter an expression or use provided buttons for functions.

faqs.question: Is eval safe?
faqs.answer: Eval executes user input—ensure no untrusted code; for production use a math parser library.

faqs.question: Does it support trig?
faqs.answer: Yes—use Math.sin(), Math.cos(), Math.tan() with radians.

faqs.question: Can I use parentheses?
faqs.answer: Yes—standard JS expression rules apply.

unit.title: Unit Converter – Length, Mass, Volume & More
unit.metaDescription: Convert common units across length, weight, volume, area, speed and temperature.
unit.introduction: Supports a selection of common units with accurate conversion factors.

faqs.question: How many units supported?
faqs.answer: This page supports the most common length units; more categories can be added.

faqs.question: Are conversions precise?
faqs.answer: Yes—based on standard scientific conversion factors.

faqs.question: Can I convert temperature?
faqs.answer: Temperature uses different formulas (C↔F↔K) handled separately.

volume.title: Volume Calculator – cube, sphere, cylinder
volume.metaDescription: Calculate volume of common 3D shapes quickly.
volume.introduction: Enter shape dimensions (radius, height, side) to compute volume.

faqs.question: Volume of cylinder?
faqs.answer: V = π × r² × h.

faqs.question: Units?
faqs.answer: Results in same cubic units as inputs.

clock.title: World Clock – Multiple City Times
clock.metaDescription: View current times in multiple cities worldwide.
clock.introduction: Select cities to view current local times and offsets.

faqs.question: Can I add custom cities?
faqs.answer: Yes—UI supports adding custom cities by timezone ID.

faqs.question: Is DST handled?
faqs.answer: Yes when using IANA timezone IDs in the browser.

faqs.question: Does it sync time?
faqs.answer: Times are read from browser and reflect local network time.
